description: cfd_2d_sediment_flume_susp in 3D (4 cells in y, the discharge W 10 four times that of the 2D case): the Eulerian suspended load with the 3D face flux D 11 2, which has no vertical flux next to the bed and the block. The concentration takes no flux through the closed faces (suspended_IM1::fill_facevel); before, the settling flux of the bed face was taken out of the diagonal a second time in 3D and the deposition w_s c_1 stayed in the water while the bed received it. The suspended concentration is not in the regression dump; it is checked through the bed (topo).
